scope: Focused new-question validation after known-defect fixes; not statistical reliability/p95 certification.

cases.text: ¿Qué duración aparece para la noche de ayer? Dámela en horas y minutos.
cases.expectation: Native current_sleep yesterday is517 minutes =8h37min, synthetic provenance. Hours+minutes; no legacy-duration substitution.

cases.text: Tell me yesterday's recorded sleep duration, strictly in minutes.
cases.expectation: Native current_sleep yesterday is517 minutes; explicit minutes request must retain minutes. Synthetic provenance.

cases.text: Estoy dándole vueltas a todo antes de acostarme. ¿Qué hago para bajar el ritmo hoy?
cases.expectation: Useful nonempty natural advice, no diagnosis or invented causality, no autonomous action or new memory. Do not force humour.

turns: How much sleep did my phone record yesterday?
Can you make that last answer shorter while keeping its source clear?
cases.expectation: Both replies preserve yesterday517 minutes =8h37min and synthetic current_sleep provenance; followup keeps context, no UUID/internal references.

cases.text: ¿Hay algún promedio válido de descanso en los registros de esta semana?
cases.expectation: All legacy sleep records have unsupported hours units with implausible values. No valid mean available; never reinterpret as minutes or zero.

cases.text: What total protection was recorded yesterday? Please use hours and minutes.
cases.expectation: 137 recorded protection minutes =2h17min. Recorded protection not phone use/time saved, no physical execution claim.
